{{short description|Mathematician}}
{{family name hatnote|Valls|Anglés|lang=Spanish}}
'''Clàudia Valls Anglés''' is a mathematician and an expert in [[dynamical system]]s. She is an associate professor in the [[Instituto Superior Técnico]] of the [[University of Lisbon]] in Portugal.{{r|istfac}}

==Education==
Valls completed a doctorate at the [[University of Barcelona]] in 1999. Her dissertation, ''The Classical Arnold Example of Diffusion with Two Equal Parameters'', was supervised by {{ill|Carles Simó Torres|ca|Carles Simó i Torres}}.{{r|mg}}

==Books==
Valls is the co-author of books with [[Luís Barreira]] and others, including:
*''Instability in Hamiltonian systems'' (with Antonio Pumariño, Electronic Journal of Qualitative Theory of Differential Equations Monograph Series, Vol. 1, 2005)
*''Stability of nonautonomous differential equations'' (with Luís Barreira, Lecture Notes in Mathematics, Vol. 1926, Springer, 2008){{r|snde}}
*''Complex analysis and differential equations'' (with Luís Barreira, Springer Undergraduate Mathematics Series, Springer, 2012), translated into French as ''Analyse complexe et équations différentielles'' (Enseignement SUP-Maths, EDP Sciences, 2011){{r|cade}}
*''Exercices d’analyse complexe et équations différentielles'' [''Exercises in complex analysis and differential equations''] (with Luís Barreira, Enseignement SUP-Maths, EDP Sciences, 2011){{r|xac}}
*''Equações diferenciais: Teoria qualitativa'' (with Luís Barreira, Ensino da Ciência e da Tecnologia, Vol. 33, IST Press, 2010), translated into English as ''Ordinary differential equations: Qualitative theory'' (Graduate Studies in Mathematics, Vol. 137, American Mathematical Society, 2012){{r|qt}}
*''Dynamical systems: An introduction'' (with Luís Barreira and Davor Dragičević, Universitext, Springer, 2013; originally published in Portuguese in 2012){{r|dsi}}
*''Exercises in linear algebra'' (with Luís Barreira, World Scientific, 2016){{r|xla}}
*''Admissibility and hyperbolicity'' (with Luís Barreira, SpringerBriefs in Mathematics, Springer, 2018){{r|ah}}
*''Dynamical systems by example'' (with Luís Barreira, Problem Books in Mathematics, Springer, 2019){{r|dsx}}
